name: swiss-panel
author: young1lin
description: The admin panel's one npm home: TypeScript sources in src/, the vitest acceptance suite in test/, and build.mjs which emits the served tree (types blanked in place, line-for-line) into ../src/admin_assets/js. The emitted JS is committed, so cargo build never needs node; node is a dev-only dependency here.

scripts.check: npm run proto:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm run test
